3. {{< fa headphones >}} [*Follow the Money: How FDI Is Redrawing the Global Economy*](https://www.mckinsey.com/mgi/our-research/follow-the-money-how-fdi-is-redrawing-the-global-economy) — McKinsey Global Institute

## In class today
- What a multinational is: FDI, control, and the ladder from exporting to owning a foreign plant
- The scale and shape of global FDI — and how the map is being redrawn
- Why firms go multinational: locational advantages, market imperfections, and the OLI framework
- Horizontal vs. vertical FDI, global value chains, and the smile curve
- A century of foreign investment, from colonial capital to security-driven fragmentation
- Whether FDI helps the countries that host it — and what it depends on
- **Student-led article presentation** (Pandya 2016)
- Writing prompt and discussion
:::
